description: Backup mirror of mVolt+, the NVIDIA GPU tuning and monitoring tool with voltage, clock, power and fan control, V/F curves, live telemetry and saved profiles.
notes: Same files as 'mvolt', downloaded from the AmirulAndalib/mvolt-scoop backup mirror instead of the upstream release. Install mvolt or mvolt-mirror, not both.
Tuning needs administrator rights. Profiles and settings live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\mVolt+ and are kept on update and uninstall.
Exit mVolt+ from the tray before running 'scoop update'.
If you use Start with Windows, mVolt+ runs its own copy from %ProgramFiles%\mVolt+. Open mVolt+ as administrator once after each update to refresh it, and turn the option off before uninstalling.
